message: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Please refund the duplicate payment.
purpose: Clear billing case: catches a model that cannot do the basic task.

message: Since the latest update the app crashes every time I try to open a project. I've reinstalled twice.
purpose: Clear technical case: a bug report with no money involved.

message: We're a team of 40 and are thinking about upgrading to your enterprise plan. Can someone send me pricing?
purpose: Clear sales case: mentions money (pricing) but is a purchase inquiry, so it catches a model that sees 'price' and says billing.

message: Your checkout page threw an error but my card was still charged and I never got access.
purpose: Ambiguous case: both a bug and a charge; accepts either answer, catches only a wrong third category or unknown.

message: What's a good recipe for banana bread that doesn't use eggs?
purpose: Not a support request: must yield unknown; catches a model that forces every message into a category (hallucination).
